data.additional_information:
We are seeking an Aerospace Engineer to drive the conceptual design, sizing, performance analysis, and flight-physics evaluation of our UAV platforms — covering multirotor, fixed-wing, and hybrid VTOL configurations. The role spans aerodynamics, flight mechanics, propulsion-airframe matching, stability and control, and aeroelastic clearance. The candidate will work closely with structures, propulsion, autonomy, and flight test teams to take a UAV from a clean-sheet concept through to flight-qualified vehicle. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
1. Conceptual Design & Sizing: Perform vehicle-level sizing, performance estimation, and configuration trade studies (multirotor, fixed-wing, hybrid VTOL, etc.) using analytical tools, MATLAB, etc. Define mission-driven design points and operating envelopes. 
2. Aerodynamics & CFD (if applicable): Conduct aerodynamic analysis using XFLR5, ANSYS Fluent / Dassault Simulia. Generate aerodynamic databases for stability, control, and performance. Support wind-tunnel test planning and correlation when required 
3. Flight Mechanics, Stability & Control: Develop 6-DOF flight dynamics models, derive stability and control derivatives, design control allocation for multirotor and tilt-rotor configurations, and support autopilot tuning in collaboration with the autonomy team. 
4. Propulsion–Airframe Integration: Match propulsion systems (electric, hybrid, fuel-cell) to airframes — including propeller selection, motor sizing, ESC compatibility, energy budgeting, and rotor–airframe interaction studies. 
5. Aeroelasticity & Loads: Perform flutter, divergence, and dynamic load analysis for fixed-wing and hybrid configurations. Define flight load cases for the structures team and clear the platform aeroelastically before first flight. 
6. Flight Test Support: Plan instrumentation, support flight test campaigns, analyse flight data, and close the loop between predictions and measured behaviour. Maintain and continuously improve the company's vehicle performance models. 
7. Documentation & Certification Support: Prepare design notes, technical reports, and certification documents in line with applicable airworthiness standards (DGCA, MIL-HDBK, STANAG references). 
8. Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams for design intent, specifications, and technical concepts of the product. 
9. IP Development & Knowledge Building: Contribute to Patents and Internal design guidelines 

Skills Required 

1. Strong fundamentals in low-Reynolds-number aerodynamics, propeller/rotor aerodynamics, flight mechanics, and stability & control. 
2. Hands-on experience with at least one CFD package (ANSYS Fluent /Dassault Simulia / OpenFOAM / Star-CCM+) and one low-fidelity tool (XFLR5, AVL, VSP). (if applicable) 
3. Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink and Python for vehicle modelling, simulation, and data analysis. 
4. Exposure to flight testing, instrumentation, and test data reduction is desirable. 
5. Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly across mechanical, autonomy, and electronics teams. 
6. Ability to lead, collaborate, and communicate effectively across disciplines. 
7. Familiarity with FEA and CFD concepts to guide and review analysis performed by the team. 
8. Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. Willingness to learn from and contribute to the knowledge of others

Education Qualification- PhD.M.tech/M.E
Experience Required-0-2 Yrs
